An anchor wrapping a block that holds another anchor records its destination once, not twice

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<a href=\"/o\"><div><a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
